meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Oman (unitary national jurisdiction, no sub-state corporate registers)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - Civil Law statutory framework supplemented by Islamic Sharia principles and GCC commercial practice
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Oman-United States Free Trade Agreement (in force 2009)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Royal Decree No. 30/2016 (Law on Combating Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism), as amended by Royal Decree No. 63/2020; Royal Decree No. 18/2019 (Commercial Companies Law), Articles 30-36 and 268; MoCIIP Ministerial Decision No. 121/2019 (Register of Beneficial Owners); CMA Decision No. 21/2019 (Capital Market Entities UBO Rules); National Centre for Financial Information Executive Regulations; Central Bank of Oman Circulars on AML/CFT.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of the sole corporate foreign shareholder (if the shareholder is a legal entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country companies registry / competent authority in the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Oman acceded to the Hague Apostille Convention with effect from 12 January 2021) or Consular Legalization by the Omani Embassy where the issuer is not a Hague member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the passport pages of the beneficial owner, director and authorized signatories of the shareholder and of the SPC manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in country of residence or issuing passport authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized board resolution of the sole corporate shareholder authorizing incorporation of the SPC, appointing the manager, and approving initial capital contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds certificate from the shareholder's principal bank covering the initial share capital and first-year operating budget
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing commercial bank or licensed financial institution

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: General Power of Attorney appointing Omani legal counsel and registered agent for pre-incorporation filings and municipal licensing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the shareholder's jurisdiction or Omani notary public if executed domestically
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization plus Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication if executed abroad

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, managers and authorized signatories against the UN Consolidated List, US OFAC SDN List, UK HMT Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Omani domestic sanctions designations administered by the National Centre for Financial Information and the Oman Sanctions Committee. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), including family members and close associates, trigger enhanced due diligence, senior-management approval, and mandatory 12-month periodic review. Negative news and adverse-media checks are required before onboarding as low-risk standard tier is rebuttable by any adverse match.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Invest Easy e-Government portal of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP), https://investeasy.gov.om
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Commercial names must be registered in Arabic as the official registry language; a Latin-script transliteration may be added as the company's secondary foreign name. Transliteration from Arabic to English must follow the standard Omani registry transliteration table. Where the proposed name includes an English/French linguistic element (e.g., 'CFO Advisory'), an Arabic transliteration is mandatory and the combined name must not exceed the registry character limits.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Central Bank of Oman, 'Bank' and 'Finance' without CBO license
Names violating public order, morality or Islamic religious sensitivities
Terms misrepresenting the licensed activity (e.g., 'Insurance', 'Investment Fund', 'Securities') without the relevant financial regulator's approval
Names identical, substantially similar, or confusingly similar to an existing Omani registered trade name or global trademark
Geographic references implying a branch or affiliation with a foreign state or international organization
Words creating an imputation of official sponsorship or misleading commercial capacity
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant receives a written registry explanation through Invest Easy. The applicant may file a reconsideration request with the MoCIIP Commercial Registration Directorate within 30 calendar days of rejection, attaching comparative evidence of distinctiveness and any letters of consent from existing rights holders. If the reconsideration is refused, a formal administrative appeal may be lodged with the Ministry's Legal Affairs Committee within 30 days of the second rejection. Pending appellate review, the applicant may simultaneously reserve an alternative acceptable name to prevent delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A purely non-physical virtual office without a physical location in Oman is not permissible for issuance of the Commercial Registration certificate. However, licensed co-working suites and 'service office' arrangements provided by licensed business centers in Muscat or Sohar are acceptable premises for a low-risk professional consultancy as long as a physical leased desk/office is maintained, the address appears on the Commercial Register and license, and mail receipt is verifiable. Home-office registration is generally not accepted for licensed commercial activities.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Medium - approximately 30% probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months by MoCIIP or municipal inspectors; the probability rises to 40% if the registered service office is located in a shared facility and to 50% upon any complaint, use of residential address, or mismatch between declared activity and physical equipment presence.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Companies Law of the Sultanate of Oman, Royal Decree No. 18/2019, as amended by Royal Decree No. 83/2022, including the Single Person Company and Limited Liability Company formation chapters, the general commercial register and publication provisions, and the Foreign Capital Investment Law (Royal Decree No. 50/2019) national-treatment provisions; applicable MoCIIP fee and e-registration ministerial decisions.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Companies Registration Department, Directorate General of Commercial Registration and Licensing, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP), Sultanate of Oman; filings are accepted through the InvestEasy One-Stop Portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Single Person Company Constitution Deed (Memorandum and Articles of Association / النظام الأساسي لشركة الشخص الواحد), registered in the Commercial Register and evidenced by the Commercial Registration Certificate (Sijil).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is fixed by Royal Decree No. 18/2019 for Single Person Companies; the subscribed capital is determined in the constitution deed. The full declared capital must be deposited in an Oman-licensed bank account before registration and evidenced by a Capital Deposit Certificate; the funds become unrestricted once the Commercial Registration Certificate is issued. For this services scope, standard practice recommends a declared paid-up capital of OMR 10,000 (approx. USD 26,000) to support expatriate visa quotas.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST RESOLUTION OF THE SOLE SHAREHOLDER AND BOARD OF [COMPANY] SPC — (1) The Single Person Company is deemed validly incorporated; the Memorandum and Articles of Association are adopted as filed with the MoCIIP Commercial Register. (2) The sole shareholder subscribes to the full issued paid-up capital; the bank Capital Deposit Certificate is confirmed as evidence of payment. (3) The registered office at [address, Muscat Governorate, Oman] is formally adopted. (4) The Founder is appointed Managing Director/General Manager, authorized to open bank accounts, appoint external auditors, execute agreements, and complete all physical and municipal licensing. (5) The Managing Director shall complete post-incorporation regulatory filings without further shareholder resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reserve Trade Name and Confirm Approved Activity Scope
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Directorate General of Commercial Registration, MoCIIP — InvestEasy Portal (www.investeasy.gov.om)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the InvestEasy commercial register portal, verify the proposed Arabic trade name against registered names, select the standard activity code for administrative, bookkeeping and financial advisory services (ISIC 6920 / digital CFO services), pay the name reservation fee, and download the name reservation certificate (valid for 90 days).
required_dossiers: Proposed Arabic trade name with SPC designation
Declared activity scope and ISIC coding
Passport photograph of the appointed manager
Contact details and preliminary registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or contradiction, resubmit with alternate distinct names or lodge a written objection with the MoCIIP Name Review Committee; if the activity code is rejected, expand the scope with auxiliary ISIC codes (e.g., 7020 management consultancy) and resubmit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarize the Single Person Company Constitution Deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Department, Ministry of Justice — Governorate of Muscat
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the bilingual (Arabic/English) Memorandum and Articles of Association for the Single Person Company. The sole shareholder signs before the Notary Public, with the notary authenticating the deed and each annexed capital clause, governance provision, and registered office. Collect the notarized original and certified copies.
required_dossiers: Draft MOA/AOA in Arabic (English translation annexed)
Notarized power of attorney if executed through a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary queries the capital clause, governance provisions, or name wording, amend the deed, re-attest the corrected version, and pay the re-notarization fee before resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open Company Bank Account and Deposit Paid-Up Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial bank in Oman — AML/KYC compliance department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized constitution deed to the selected Omani bank, complete corporate account opening and beneficial ownership declarations, and deposit the declared paid-up capital. Obtain the bank's Capital Deposit Certificate (share-capital deposit certificate) for the commercial register application.
required_dossiers: Passports and proof of address of beneficial owner and manager
Letter of intended activities and projected transaction flows
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank's compliance unit requests further source-of-funds evidence, provide bank statements, employment records, or audited group financials; escalate to the branch AML officer; alternatively apply through a second licensed bank.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File with the Commercial Register and Obtain the Commercial Registration Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registration Department, MoCIIP — InvestEasy filing window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the incorporation application through InvestEasy attaching the notarized constitution deed and Capital Deposit Certificate; pay the statutory registration fee; the registry verifies the deed, name, and paid-up capital, then issues the Commercial Registration Certificate (Sijil) and registers the company in the commercial register. Collect the signed electronic certificate and company Sijil record.
required_dossiers: Registered office lease or usufruct evidence
Consent letter of the appointed manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the examiner issues a query or defect notice, respond within 15 working days through the portal with corrected filings; if the application is refused, appeal to the MoCIIP Under-Secretary within 30 days citing completed statutory documents.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA) – الهيئة العامة للضرائب; central digital platform: Mutanef (منتفع) / Taxa e-services portal (taxa.om), integrated with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) Invest Easy single-window for commercial registration
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A 100% foreign-owned Single Person Company (SPC) must first secure the Commercial Registration (CR) certificate via the MoCIIP Invest Easy platform; following incorporation, the SPC must apply on the Tax Authority Mutanef portal for the unified Tax Identification Number (TIN) covering both Corporate Income Tax (CIT) and VAT. Mandatory registration is triggered when annual taxable supplies exceed OMR 38,500; voluntary registration is permitted from OMR 19,250. Supporting documents include: notarized and attested Articles of Incorporation/SPC constitution, Commercial Registration certificate, business license for ISIC 6920 / NAICS 541219, passport copy and Emirates ID/Omani residency documents of the foreign member and CFO-director nominee, board resolution delegating a registered tax agent, audited financial statements (where requested), and a certified power of attorney for the appointed agent.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation – the Omani SPC is a distinct juridical person subject to the Omani Income Tax Law (Royal Decree 28/2009, as amended by Royal Decree 9/2023) and the new Corporate Income Tax Law; taxable at a 15% flat corporate income tax rate on profits determined under arm's length accounting with territorial scope over Oman-source income; no pass-through or transparent classification is available
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Oman applies a rigid entity-level regime without US-style check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections. Statutory elections are limited to: (i) VAT Tax Group election under the Oman VAT Law (Royal Decree 121/2020) for 100%-related resident entities; (ii) voluntary VAT registration election above OMR 19,250; (iii) small-business CIT relief/exemption application where the business falls within OMR-prescribed SME thresholds; (iv) election of the standard quarterly VAT filing cycle or annual simplified cycle; (v) irrevocable election to deduct input VAT under the general meaning of business for holding/management activities; and (vi) appointment of a tax agent through the Mutanef portal.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (GCC Value Added Tax regime under the Unified GCC VAT Agreement, enacted by Oman Royal Decree No. 121/2020)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: OMR 38,500 mandatory registration threshold on annual taxable supplies and imports (approx. USD 100,000); OMR 19,250 voluntary threshold; non-resident suppliers must register regardless of turnover where the state of supply is Oman and the non-resident is the deemed supplier; a separate OMR 1,000 import-based registration trigger applies for persons only carrying imports into Oman
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Oman is in the transition phase toward a national mandatory e-invoicing regime. The OTA has announced a phased continuous transaction control (CTC) clearance mandate for B2B and B2G invoices, with sequenced go-live for large filers from 2026 (taxpayer registration, certified provider onboarding, and real-time clearance in the Mutanef platform). Current obligations require all VAT-registered businesses to issue machine-readable e-invoices with QR-compliant digital stamping, to retain structured audit files (SAF) for tax audits, and to report invoice-level data in the annual/provisional VAT returns; paper originals and manual invoice registers are no longer accepted for input VAT recovery.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (0% VAT) is available where: (i) goods are physically exported outside the GCC by the SPC or on its behalf, delivery occurs within the contract and the goods leave Oman within 90 days of the time of supply, with customs export confirmation; (ii) services are supplied for the direct benefit of a non-resident person who is outside Oman and for whom the benefit is entirely enjoyed outside the GCC (the virtual CFO advisory and multicurrency bookkeeping services must not be consumed in Oman and must not relate to moveable/immovable Omani property); (iii) transport and ancillary transport services relating to the export of goods from Oman to a place outside the GCC; (iv) supplies directly connected to a qualifying GCC customs suspension arrangement. Input VAT attributable exclusively to zero-rated supplies is creditable in full; mixed-use expenditure must be apportioned on an acceptable pro-rata method agreed with the OTA.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration / SAD issued via the Omani Customs Bayan/e-SABI electronic system, sealed and date-stamped
Commercial invoice for the export sale (showing OMR 0% VAT line and export zero-rating note)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical dispatch from Oman to a non-GCC destination
CBO bank statement or Inward Remittance Certificate evidencing receipt of foreign currency proceeds into the SPC's Omani bank account
Original purchase/contract documentation for the CFO and bookkeeping services demonstrating the non-resident benefit and place of supply
Delivery/export movement record (container, seal, port-to-port tracking) and any certificate of origin where required by the destination customs authority
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating claims are subject to documentary and bank-reconciliation review by the OTA during post-clearance audits (five-year statutory time bar). Where the export is challenged, the SPC must substantiate the 0% line within 30 days of inquiry; failure results in reversal of the zero-rating, assessment at 5% VAT with late payment penalties of 13% annualized interest (per the VAT Executive Regulations), and cash fines of OMR 500–10,000 per infraction. Fraudulent or fictitious exports, forged customs declarations, or non-repatriation of proceeds within the 180-day tolerance trigger anti-evasion sanctions: restitution of the input VAT re-credited, aggravated fines of not less than 100% of tax evaded (up to double the evaded amount), disqualification of the foreign member/director, suspension of the CR license, and referral to the Public Prosecution for tax evasion imprisonment penalties. The SPC is also exposed to clawback of any export refund already paid, plus compulsory audit of the prior three tax years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO) — Foreign Exchange Administration under Royal Decree 87/88, Banking Law, and AML/CFT Law (Royal Decree 30/2016 as amended).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial is pegged to the U.S. Dollar at 1 OMR = 2.60028 USD. Current account transactions, including service fees, royalties, dividends, and profit remittances, are effectively convertible through licensed banks subject to AML/KYC compliance and documentary verification. Capital account transactions, including the injection and repatriation of foreign direct investment capital for a 100% foreign-owned SPC, are permitted under Oman's Foreign Investment Law and require filing of the MOCIIP foreign investment return, audited financial statements, and tax clearance from the Oman Tax Authority before a remitting bank will process the outflow. No generalized surrender or lock-in requirements apply to a Low-Risk advisory SPC, but banks will require proper purpose codes, underlying contracts, and CBO reporting forms for any transactions exceeding regulatory thresholds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Oman does not impose a mandatory OMR conversion ratio or an automatic surrender requirement for export receipts. For goods exports, proceeds must be repatriated through a licensed authorized bank within six months from the date of the bill of lading or equivalent customs document, unless an extension has been obtained from the CBO. For cross-border service exports, including outsourced advisory and virtual-CFO services, inward receipts must be settled through the SPC's bank account within a commercially reasonable period, generally not exceeding 180 days from invoice date, and must be reported in the bank's CBO foreign-currency statement. Foreign-currency receipts may be held in transferable USD accounts at Omani banks, but any OMR clearing or government-related payment will require conversion through a CBO-licensed dealer.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account with OMR and USD multi-currency sub-accounts
Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account
Operational Account and Liquidity Sweep Account
Operational Account with International Treasury Connect

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. The Central Bank of Oman does not currently license a separate Omani electronic-money-institution license equivalent to the EU EMI framework. A foreign/offshore digital EMI such as Wise or Stripe cannot hold a domestic OMR settlement account or clear through the Oman Automated Clearing House without a licensed Omani sponsor bank or agency arrangement. Such EMIs may be used only as peripheral invoicing/collection rails in USD or EUR for non-Omani clients, provided the EMI is authorised in its home jurisdiction and all final OMR liquidity is routed through a licensed Omani bank. The SPC should treat offshore EMIs as auxiliary collection channels, not as the primary treasury or FX clearing counterparty.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical presence and in-person KYC interview is generally mandated for the executive director or an authorized senior signatory of a 100% foreign-owned Omani SPC before account activation. A notarized and apostilled power-of-attorney may allow secondary signatories to be appointed remotely, but at least one principal reconstruction shareholder/director must attend an in-branch interview or, in certain banks, a CBO-approved licensed video-verification session. Full remote opening without any physical interaction is not generally permitted for non-resident-owned SPCs.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident beneficial owner without an Omani national ID or resident card
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified passport copy; proof of overseas residential address; beneficial-ownership declaration under the Omani Commercial Companies Law; CRS-CBCR self-certification; written bank reference from the shareholder's home-country bank; and signed source-of-funds declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly incorporated SPC with no audited financial statements or prior operating history
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: MOCIIP Commercial Registration Certificate; Articles of Association; capital contribution evidence; six months of personal or corporate bank statements from the originator; client engagement letters; pro-forma invoices; board resolution authorizing the initial capital; and a written explanation of the treasury structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Low-risk advisory classification but high transaction velocity or multi-currency receipts from foreign payment processors
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid commercial license; Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion foreign investment certificate; client contracts and invoices; details of the underlying outsourced-CFO services; anti-money-laundering policies of the foreign PSP; and a clear funds-flow diagram showing collection, conversion, tax, and settlement legs.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Receiving third-party remittances or secrecy-id-issuing jurisdictions lacking clarity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial reason for the tripartite payment; underlying service agreement; UBO register and confirmation of no PEP exposure; economic-substance statement where applicable; letters of confirmation from the remitting bank; and an undertaking to provide transaction-level documents within 48 hours if requested.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Initial paid-up capital from the non-resident parent or investor must be injected via SWIFT MT103 from the corporate bank account in the home jurisdiction to the SPC's licensed bank account in Oman. The remittance instruction must include the Omani corporate name, the purpose code 'Direct Investment Capital Injection' (BOP equivalent code 101), the SPC's Commercial Registration number, and reference to the MOCIIP foreign investment registration. The receiving Omani bank will validate the capital flow against the investment license, credit the capital escrow or operational account, and file the required CBO inward remittance report. Informal value-transfer methods, cash deposits, or crypto routing are not acceptable and will trigger account freezing and a Suspicious Transaction Report.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For outbound settlement of trade or service obligations, the SPC must use licensed clearing rails: SWIFT MT103 for service fees and subcontractor disbursements; SWIFT MT700/MT710 for documentary commercial letters of credit; and MT400/MT202 for bank-to-bank reimbursements or internal cash concentration. The disbursing Omani bank requires an underlying invoice, proof of service receipt, tax-registration certificate, and, where the threshold exceeds the bank's internal reporting trigger, a CBO foreign-remittance form. Cross-border disbursements in OMR are generally restricted; payments must be settled in USD or other freely convertible currencies using the CBO-licensed dealing room rate.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX spot transactions for OMR/USD and USD-cross pairs through licensed Omani banks at the official pegged exchange rate.
Deliverable FX forwards up to 365 days with a licensed Omani bank, subject to evidence of underlying foreign-currency exposure and ISDA/CSA documentation.
Cross-currency swaps between OMR and USD for asset-liability matching or currency-mismatch hedging, executed through a CBO-licensed bank.
Simple European-style foreign-currency options with a CBO-licensed bank, permissible only for hedging underlying commercial exposure, not for speculative trading.

Overseas offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing OMR/USD are not permissible as the primary hedge; Oman's pegged exchange rate and the absence of an independent offshore onshore OMR deliverability pool make such contracts legally unenforceable for local regulatory capital relief.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of Commercial Registration and Municipal Business Licence
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MCIIP) and the competent Municipal Authority via the InvestEasy portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the expiry date shown on the Commercial Register certificate; municipal licence renewal is processed concurrently with the commercial registration anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory late-renewal surcharge applied per month; continued non-renewal for six months leads to suspension of the active commercial status and referral for administrative strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months after the end of the SPC financial year; for a 31 December year-end, no later than 31 March of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fines and late-payment interest imposed by the Oman Tax Authority; continued failure to file may result in estimated tax assessment, enforced collection, and ultimately administrative strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Audited Financial Statements and shareholder approval record
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders and Oman Tax Authority; MCIIP inspection upon request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the financial year-end; for a 31 December year-end, no later than 30 June of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Contravention of the Commercial Companies Law; statutory fines may be imposed for failure to prepare and present audited annual accounts, and repeated failure supports Ministry-ordered strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner declaration and register update confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MCIIP Beneficial Ownership Register and Oman Tax Authority as applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the Commercial Register renewal expiry date; any share transfer or ownership change must additionally be reported within 15 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalties under Oman AML/CFT legislation, including fines for non-filing or false UBO information, and administrative strike-off for persistent non-compliance

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No turnover or capital exemption applies to an Omani Single Person Company; a licensed auditor registered in Oman must be appointed for every financial year and the annual accounts must be audited
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Financial statements must be prepared under IFRS as adopted in Oman; IFRS for SMEs is available for non-public entities where no consolidation or larger-entity obligation applies

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SPC must maintain a current register of beneficial owners and confirm its contents annually at Commercial Register renewal. Any shareholding transfer must be reflected in the corporate registers and notified to MCIIP within 15 days; the annual confirmation confirms no change or attaches the updated UBO schedule

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% flat on taxable income above OMR 100,000 (foreign-owned SPC; no small-business bracket)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No tax holidays under the Income Tax Law (RD 28/2009) for standard consultancy activities; 3% and 5% preferential brackets apply only to Omani/GCC wholly-owned small businesses with taxable income up to OMR 30,000 and OMR 100,000 respectively; SPC is subject to 15% flat rate.
